_comment: High/critical advisories accepted with a review-by date. The CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) fails on any production high/critical package NOT listed here, and also fails on any entry whose reviewBy date has passed. Every entry must be unreachable in Waykeep's runtime and re-justified by reviewBy.

allow.reason: libvips CVEs in the transformers.js image pipeline; Waykeep embeds text only and never invokes the image path.
Transitive under @huggingface/transformers; no upstream fix. Model bytes are SHA-256 pin-verified before load, so no untrusted model input reaches it.
4GB-allocation from a crafted ZIP via onnxruntime-node model unpacking; Waykeep only unpacks pinned, hash-verified model archives, never arbitrary ones.
Chain root of the three above; inherits their advisories with no fix available. Revisit when a release lifts the onnxruntime/sharp chain.
